text: わしの　かわりに　いって　くれんか！

patterns.name: 〜てくれないか
patterns.explanation: くれないか after a て-form verb asks someone to do you a favour; くれん is the old-man form of くれない. いって くれんか = 'won't you go for me?'.

patterns.name: 〜のかわりに
patterns.explanation: のかわりに after a person means doing something instead of them. わしの かわりに = 'in my place'.
